toeGroundLock.purpose: keep the distal toe patch loaded as the metatarsal begins its late-stance rise

preserve: accepted V8.1 posture, pivots, contact solver and non-walk motion
contact lead at +0.54 hip heights; target rear reach approximately -0.46 hip heights
intent.lateStance: During the final 20% of stance, raise the rear/metatarsal foot through the existing foot-pivot rocker while toe branches counter-articulate and their selected ground patch remains loaded; release toe contact only after rocker completion.
